release.name: Release practice
release.intro: Don't push the feeling down or pick it apart. Just let it be here, then choose to let it go. About 3 minutes.

topic.title: Think of something that's on your mind right now
topic.hint: Write a line, or just hold it in mind
topic.placeholder: e.g. Presenting tomorrow and a bit nervous

before.title: How strong is this feeling right now?

steps.title: First, let it be here
steps.text: No need to chase it away or figure out why. Notice where you feel it — chest, shoulders, stomach. Take three slow breaths.

steps.title: Could I let it go?
steps.text: Yes or no — both are fine. Just answer honestly.

steps.title: Would I let it go?
steps.text: This is about whether you're willing, not whether you should.

steps.title: When?
steps.text: If you're willing, now. Breathe out gently and let it loosen a little.

release.again: Some of it is still here, and that's normal. Want to go another round?
release.done: Well done. Feelings come and go — you don't have to keep holding on.
release.note: This is a relaxation exercise, not therapy. If your feelings are heavy or last a long time, talk to someone close to you or a professional.
